purchase_instructions.headline_warning: ⚠️ SP purchase is IRREVERSIBLE. Once executed, you commit to a fixed hourly fee for 365 days. AWS does NOT allow cancellation, refund, or grace-period reversal.

summary.product: 1 year No Upfront Compute Savings Plan
summary.coverage_scope: All EC2 BoxUsage (non-Spot) + Fargate + Lambda across all member accounts in Org o-4bw6d7ou28

step_1_lookup_offering_id.purpose: Fetch the current Compute SP offering ID. AWS offering IDs are stable per region/term/payment combination but should be re-fetched at purchase time to guarantee freshness.
step_1_lookup_offering_id.command: aws savingsplans describe-savings-plans-offerings --profile aws-002497567426-us-tech-service --plan-types Compute --durations 31536000 --currencies USD --payment-options 'No Upfront' --query 'searchResults[?planType==`Compute`] | [0].offeringId' --output text
step_1_lookup_offering_id.expected_output: A single offering ID string (UUID-like, ~36 chars)
failure_modes: Empty output → offering not available in this region; check AWS service health
Multiple results → query filter needs tightening

step_2_create_savings_plan.purpose: THE IRREVERSIBLE PURCHASE STEP. After this command succeeds, you are committed to paying $8.3000/hr × 8760 hours = $72,708.00 regardless of actual usage.

--profile.why_this_value: SP is bought at the Org payer account 002497567426; coverage propagates to all member accounts via consolidated billing.

--savings-plan-offering-id.meaning: AWS internal SKU identifying the SP product
--savings-plan-offering-id.why_fresh: AWS rotates offering IDs when pricing changes

--commitment.meaning: Fixed hourly fee AWS will charge for 365 days
--commitment.source_of_truth: Computed by aws-sp-optimizer using newsvendor formula

--client-token.safety: Same token → same SP (no double-purchase). Change the token only for a genuinely new purchase.

--tags.purpose: Resource tags for audit trail. They appear in CUR's resource_tags_aws_* columns for correlation with this run.

what_aws_does_when_executed: 1. Authenticates the request against the profile's IAM policy
2. Validates the offering ID is currently purchasable
3. Validates the commitment is within account SP quota (default $1000/hr)
4. Creates the SavingsPlan resource (state: payment-pending → active)
5. Begins accruing the hourly fee immediately upon 'active' state
6. Begins applying the SP discount to eligible compute usage immediately
what_aws_does_NOT_do: Send an email confirmation — the purchase is silent
Allow cancellation, refund, or adjustment within any grace period
Warn you if the commitment exceeds your historical usage
Prorate the first hour — billing starts from the hour of activation
Check that the commitment matches other SPs you already own

immediate_check.expected: One entry with state='active' (or 'payment-pending' initially), start=today, end=today+365d

post_purchase_verification.utilization_check_at_week_1: aws ce get-savings-plans-utilization --profile aws-002497567426-us-tech-service --time-period Start=<today+7d>,End=<today+8d> --granularity DAILY

safety_checklist_before_running.check: No new SP purchased since recommendation
safety_checklist_before_running.expected: Same set of active SPs as when recommendation was generated

safety_checklist_before_running.condition: Recommendation was generated at most 7 days ago

alternatives_if_not_confident.rationale: If AWS's own algo gives a similar number (±20%), confidence is high
